page.overview:
Who is Gine?

She wears a sleeveless black bodysuit and dark green combat armor highlighted with bronze and outlined by white, in addition to magenta armbands and white boots. Her armor also features a thigh-length hoop. Like all Saiyans in her respective universe, she naturally possesses a tail. Unlike most adult Saiyans seen in combat, she lets her tail sway freely rather than securing it around her waist. This is common practice for Saiyans while at home on Planet Vegeta, as wrapping the tail is primarily a battlefield tactic; Bardock is also known to let his tail hang loose while at home in Dragon Ball Minus, Broly, and Dragon Ball Super.

In Dragon Ball Z: Extreme Butōden, she wears pink battle armor with blue armbands.

Gine possesses a gentle, kindhearted, and cheerful personality. Unlike most of her race, she is energetic, caring, and exhibits a pure heart similar to her youngest son and both grandsons. Due to this temperament, she is not cut out for fighting. Furthermore, she develops a genuine bond of companionship and love with Bardock; this is a rare case for Saiyans, who typically do not develop romantic unions outside of breeding purposes.

Despite her gentleness, she is fiercely protective of her younger son. She argues with Bardock regarding the decision to send Kakarot to Earth as an infiltration baby, fearing the danger of the mission. She also expresses pride in Raditz for his assignment to a team with Prince Vegeta, demonstrating deep maternal love for both of her sons.
